title: Application of Massachusettts Electric Company , under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 797, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quaterly Power Cost Chargeto be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of October, November and December, 1993. The Power Cost Charge reflects changes in prudently incured, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company. Application is also made by Massachusetts Electric Company, for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilitiesfor purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. set forth the filings to be made by utilitieswith the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
